paper.title_en: Compact Dark Matter with Globular Cluster Pulsars
paper.abstract_en: Pulsars are exceptionally stable clocks, and a compact dark-matter object passing near the line of sight to a pulsar delays its pulses through the Shapiro effect. The number of detectable transits is set by the integral over the dark-matter density along the line of sight connecting the Earth and the pulsar. Established pulsars in pulsar timing arrays are typically within one kiloparsec of the Earth and hence sit in a dark-matter density comparable to our local value. In this work, we explore globular clusters in the inner Galaxy as targets to search for compact dark matter. These high-pulsar-density environments can be cheaply observed with a single telescope beam and enjoy a large dark-matter crossing rate. Additionally, since the recently detected nanohertz gravitational-wave background is nearly common to the cluster's pulsars, a multi-pulsar analysis can remove much of its contribution. Ranking known clusters, we find that Terzan 5, with 49 pulsars, offers the best reach. A forty-year campaign of weekly four-hour visits at the sensitivity envisioned for the second phase of the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) would probe compact objects making up $6\%$ of the dark matter at $0.02\,M_\odot$. Finally, we estimate the foreground from stars and stellar remnants in Terzan 5 and along the sightline. It is subdominant near the most sensitive low-mass part of the SKA benchmark, but becomes important over parts of the stellar mass range.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文提出利用球状星团中的脉冲星搜寻致密暗物质的新方案，属于脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）相关方向，兼具暗物质探测与纳赫兹引力波背景处理，理论动机明确且方法具体，值得点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 利用球状星团脉冲星搜寻致密暗物质
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星是异常稳定的时钟，一个致密暗物质天体从地球到脉冲星的视线附近经过时，会通过 Shapiro 效应使其脉冲延迟。可探测穿越事件的数目由沿连接地球与脉冲星的视线方向上对暗物质密度的积分决定。脉冲星计时阵列中已有的脉冲星通常位于距地球一千秒差距以内，因而处于与我们本地值相当的暗物质密度中。在本工作中，我们探索内银河系中的球状星团作为搜寻致密暗物质的目标。这些高脉冲星密度的环境可以用单个望远镜波束低成本地观测，并具有很高的暗物质穿越率。此外，由于最近探测到的纳赫兹引力波背景对星团中的脉冲星几乎是共通的，多脉冲星分析可以去除其大部分贡献。在对已知星团进行排序后，我们发现拥有 49 颗脉冲星的 Terzan 5 提供了最佳探测能力。一项为期四十年、每周进行四小时观测、灵敏度按平方公里阵列（SKA）第二阶段设想的活动，将能够探测在 $0.02\,M_\odot$ 处构成暗物质 $6\%$ 的致密天体。最后，我们估计了 Terzan 5 中以及沿视线方向上恒星和恒星遗迹产生的前景。在 SKA 基准最敏感的低质量部分附近，该前景是次主导的，但在恒星质量范围的部分区域会变得重要。
